name: ebb-ai — carbon-aware deferral
description: Auto-defer "do it later" tasks. Invoke when the user signals deferral ("by tomorrow", "tonight", "overnight", "by EOD", "sometime this week", "when you have a moment", "remind me to", "queue this up", "no rush"). Routes the LLM dispatch to the cleanest electricity-grid hour inside the deadline — 40-70% lower carbon vs running now, 50% cheaper via Anthropic/OpenAI Batch APIs.

dbPath.description: Override the SQLite queue path. Defaults to ~/.ebb-ai/queue.db (shared with the @ebb-ai/mcp MCP server and @ebb-ai/cli).

defaultRegion.description: Default electricity-grid region for scheduling when the agent does not specify one. Examples: GB, US-CAL-CISO, FR. Defaults to GB (always live data, no API key needed).
